svg.title: Hooks: defining, tool data structure, and implementing — end-to-end flow
svg.desc: Three-column diagram showing how defining a hook in settings.json, the JSON tool data sent to your script, and your implementation script all connect together.
svg.text: JSON sent to your script via stdin
Define = settings.json tells Claude Code WHEN to fire and WHAT script to run
Tool data = JSON Claude sends to your script describing the exact tool call
Implement = your script reads that JSON and exits 0 (allow) or 2 (block)
Concrete example: block Claude reading .env files
